title: History-Dependent Skill-Induced Failure: Why the Same Skill Causes Different Failure Modes Across Tasks
frozen_required_unit: Use the released SkillsBench or SWE-Skills-Bench datasets to identify matched task pairs where the same loaded skill causes a Task-Implementation Fault in both tasks. Control for task-requirement-level compatibility and skill content. If the failure mode (IRF vs. RRO) is identical across all matched pairs, the context-sensitive uptake mechanism is falsified. If failure modes vary but are predicted by static compatibility alone, the mechanism is falsified.

current_upstream.semantic_role: Answers what the current author download chain contains; it is not substituted for the paper-time experiment snapshot.

provenance_basis.resolution: First-party dataset-versioning documentation identifies the retired original arXiv-v1 86-task paper snapshot as reproducible at commit adbaf4d7; this receipt resolves that short SHA to the full commit above.

paper_v1.semantic_role: First-party commit snapshot identified for reproducing the original arXiv-v1 paper task suite; this is distinct from the later/current 87-task roster.

snapshot_roster_comparison.conclusion: Current upstream is not a one-task extension of the paper snapshot; current identities must not be used to backfill paper-run joins.

skill_identity_semantics.conclusion: The receipts call these bundled curated skill IDs, not author-provided gold labels.

missing_independent_truth: author/independent-truth per-case IRF versus RRO root-cause label
paper-run host-task identity joined to each manually adjudicated failure case
paper-run loaded-skill identity joined to each manually adjudicated failure case
why_hold: Benchmark identity/provenance is no longer the blocker. The first-party SkillsBench repository fixes current upstream at commit 9a1f4dd5f7659f75707435da3ce854b6e48321d1 and its dataset-versioning documentation identifies the original arXiv-v1 86-task paper snapshot as reproducible at commit adbaf4d7b5a9f1243c6e592e461da4414fffc997. Author task/skill code is sufficient to reconstruct agent-visible task text and the bundled curated skill-directory binding for both snapshots. However, the frozen C02 falsifier still requires independently adjudicated per-case IRF/RRO root-cause labels joined to the corresponding paper-run host-task identity and loaded-skill identity. Those manual per-case joins are not encoded in the audited SkillsBench task packages, and the audited source arXiv:2608.11888 provides aggregate/manual-consensus failure information rather than a released per-case annotation table usable as independent truth. Inferring IRF/RRO from task text, outcomes, heuristics, or an LLM would replace the frozen truth source. Support therefore remains HOLD, narrowed specifically to the failure-label join rather than benchmark provenance.
reopen_only_if: Reopen only when a first-party per-case annotation/release, or an independently reviewed equivalent truth source, joins each manually adjudicated IRF/RRO case to stable paper-time host-task identity and loaded-skill identity without inferring labels from task text/outcomes and without substituting current-upstream task identities for the paper-time experiment.
